messages:
deploy-bot: green_circle starting config-only rollout cfg-2026-03-qofloor-02 -> staging then canary. Delta: per-tenant min_qps=4, route_weight_floor=0.03, default_timeout_ms 850->700, batch_max_tokens 2048->1600, kv_cache_prefetch=on. Canary plan: 2% -> 12% -> 50% with 30m soak. Change window: immediate for staging, canary start now. Rollback playbook linked in ops checklist.

nina: quick q 12 why drop timeout to 700? worried about p99 spikes during cold starts for some tenants. Any fast-fallback? :eyes: 

sam: shorter timeout aims to let offenders fail fast so backend capacity isn't tied up. Fallbacks: kv_cache_prefetch + soft batching ramp. Abort criteria: global p99 > 1200ms OR any tenant p99 > 1000ms OR tenant kv_miss_rate >= baseline*2.

priya: adding alerts now: p99 by tenant, kv_miss_rate, error rate, gpu stall. Dashboard: https://obs.redwood/d/qofloor/canary-overview (shared).

jake: ready to trigger. Suggest dry-run command for audit: /deploy config-only cfg-2026-03-qofloor-02 --canary 2% --steps 12,50 --interval 1800s --tag=canary-1

deploy-bot: check_mark canary 2% started. Routing override applied to 2% for tagged routes. Monitoring active. Checkpoints at +30m and +60m.

ops-bot: baseline vs now snapshot: p50 60ms -> 62ms, p95 200ms -> 215ms, p99 430ms -> 470ms, kv_miss_rate 0.5% -> 0.6%. No throttles observed.

nina: watch tenants with skewed qps (eta-corp, beta-startup). They tend to surface issues first.

sam: noted. adding tenant alert for eta-corp p99>900ms.

(30m checkpoint) ops-bot: checkpoint: global p99 480ms, eta-corp p99 1400ms, eta-corp kv_miss_rate 1.7% (baseline 0.55%).

sam: PAUSE warning eta-corp spike seems linked to route_weight_floor; their KV cache pressure rose. Recommend pausing ramp and revert routing floor for that tenant.

priya: pausing ramp. Muting next ramp step. Will apply tenant-level pin to previous config for eta-corp.

jake: running tenant pin: /deploy config-pin --tenant=eta-corp --to=cfg-prev-2026-02-20 --reason="kv pressure post-floor"

deploy-bot: check_mark pin applied: eta-corp -> cfg-prev-2026-02-20. Canary remains 2% for others; ramp paused.

ops-bot: post-pin (5m): eta-corp p99 down to 510ms, kv_miss_rate 0.7%. global p99 485ms.

nina: good. Next steps: 1) run focused KV warmup for eta-corp keys, 2) consider softening batch_max_tokens to 1728, 3) require per-tenant gating for further ramps.

sam: agree. Action items: Priya add per-tenant gating rule; Jake prepare warmup script & runbook; I'll produce rollback snippet. Global rollback command: /deploy rollback cfg-2026-03-qofloor-02 --to=cfg-prev-2026-02-20 --scope=global

priya: drafting release note: "Config-only: QoS floor + routing floor to reduce tail cost. Adds per-tenant min_qps, reduces default timeout, tweaks batch sizing. Canary staged with per-tenant gates; eta-corp pinned during canary due to KV pressure. Monitoring + rollback playbook enabled."

jake: warmup script executed for eta-corp (synthetic traffic warming hot keys). ops-bot shows kv_miss_rate trending back. Ready to resume soft ramp to 12% excluding pinned tenants.

sam: proceed to 12% for non-pinned tenants only. Keep 30m watch. Immediate rollback criteria: global p99 > 1200ms OR any tenant kv_miss_rate >= baseline*2 OR error rate delta > 0.5% abs.

deploy-bot: check_mark ramp to 12% started (pinned tenants excluded). Next checkpoint +30m.

ops-bot: live snapshot: global p99 505ms, eta-corp pinned p99 520ms, kv_miss_rate overall 0.72%. No elevated errors.

nina: :thumbsup: looks safe. Schedule final 50% ramp during change window tomorrow 02:00-03:00 PT if all checks green.

priya: updating release notes & changelog; tagging config as "canary-tenant-pin-handled" for audit.

sam: retrospective note: route_weight_floor interacts poorly with cold-kv heavy tenants; add a caution in model onboarding and the config docs. If any regression occurs during the next step we revert to cfg-prev-2026-02-20 and file follow-up.

jake: thanks team. Will wait for scheduled window for full ramp.

deploy-bot: u26A1 closing thread for now (canary paused->resumed events logged). Updates will append here if rollback triggered.
